args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.0.0-rc3 (test build, built by wowfa2 CI).

New since rc2: world-map zone names (Persian / Persian + English / off, in /wowfa > Display), all 27 talent tree names, +60 spell and talent texts, and the update watch: every text the live game shows that has no Persian yet is listed on /wowfa > Status (copy it and send it in).

Ships: quest texts, quest tracker, zone names, spells, talents, settings panel (/wowfa).
Not yet: items, NPC names.
